journey.name: Incoming Payment Webhooks
journey.description: Validates that an administrator can review the payment webhooks received from Paystack and Monnify, find failed and unmatched ones first, search by payment reference, and inspect a webhook's payload, headers and errors.

story.title: Admin viewer for incoming payment webhooks

actions.action: Sign in to the Admin Dashboard, open '/dashboard/payment-gateways' and click 'Incoming webhooks'.
Verify status counts are shown and the Failed and Unmatched tiles are marked 'needs action' when their count is above zero.
Click the Failed tile and verify only failed webhooks are listed, with the last error, attempts and duplicate delivery count.
Click 'View' on a webhook and verify the payload is pretty-printed JSON (or the raw string when it is not JSON) and the stored headers are listed. Verify nothing is written to the browser console.
Search a payment reference and verify every webhook for it is listed and the status filter is ignored.
